evidence_class: mocked: a local durable directory backend behind a granted artifact store and fixture launch registrations; no object store, worker Pod or harness was used. Live G8 qualification belongs to the integration package.
interfaces: Checkpoint contract minor 2.2 types four optional fields: inventory (each material by sha256 and size), reconstruction (harness, image digest, task revision, execution generation), continuation (native or context) and branch_state (pushed or bundled)
Validator.classify decides completeness (complete, incomplete, diagnostic_only), continuation (native, context, none) and one reason code from the record alone; it never grants authority

Validator.commit is manifest last: it requires the current attempt's exact task, execution and generation, verifies every inventoried object in the granted ArtifactStore, then stores the manifest under its immutable checkpoint id and re-verifies it

Validator.verify reads the manifest and every material only through the granted ArtifactStore, so a newer attempt of the same task decides native or context continuation with the dead worker's filesystem gone

Native continuation requires a qualified native resume capability, a native session id and harness version, a consistent capture method and a native_session material; context continuation requires a normalized_transcript material and a durable transcript watermark
A path only snapshot is diagnostic_only with the reason path_only; a checkpoint below minor 2.2 is diagnostic_only with the reason legacy_minor and its fixed limitations
Validator.metrics exposes checkpoint_completeness_by_reason keyed by completeness and reason

supported_versions.checkpoint_contract: 2.0 and 2.1 read as diagnostic only; 2.2 is the typed minor and the write minor; major 3 is refused as unsupported_version
supported_versions.legacy_snapshot: The swarm snapshot document holding worktree paths and a conversation id is read as path_only and never promoted
supported_versions.storage: Any ArtifactStore backend; the cases use the local durable directory backend

authority: Scope comes only from the registration the ArtifactStore takes from its launch grant; commit requires the record authority to equal it exactly and verify requires the same task and a generation no newer than the reader's.

states.observed: Every verdict is computed from the bytes read back from the granted store
states.accepted: classify returns complete for a record whose materials and metadata are present; this carries no authority
states.committed: commit stores the manifest only after every inventoried object reads back verified
states.externally_verified: verify re-reads the stored manifest and every object by content hash before it returns an authoritative verdict

rollback_rehearsal.action: Lower the checkpoint write_minor to 1: producers write 2.1, which reads as diagnostic only, and Validator.commit refuses new promotion with promotion_disabled.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: The stored manifest object under its checkpoint id and the content addressed material objects it inventories; neither is a cache and rollback deletes neither.
rollback_rehearsal.proof: Case C rolls back after a native checkpoint is committed: a new context commit returns promotion_disabled with the durable keys unchanged, and the committed native checkpoint still verifies as authoritative.

remaining_limitations: No production caller invokes Validator yet: the plan gives the worker capture path to SV2-CKP-02 and SV2-CKP-03 and the recovery and latest pointer path to SV2-CKP-04, which call Validator.commit and Validator.verify; this package ships the contract and its verifier only.
Source capture, native session capture and the latest pointer belong to SV2-CKP-02 to SV2-CKP-04; this package defines and verifies the manifest only.
Checkpoint sequence is recorded and immutable per checkpoint id but not ordered here; SV2-CKP-04 orders it when it promotes the latest pointer.
Materials are verified by content hash and size, not by a semantic check of their contents.
artifact_hashes stays required by the contract and must agree with the inventory at 2.2.

spec_coverage.dependencies: SV2-FSY-05 supplies the scoped artifact storage: the granted ArtifactStore is the only path Validator reads or writes. SV2-CTL-05 supplies current generation ownership: Validator.commit requires the record authority to equal the attempt's task, execution and generation.
spec_coverage.source_and_materials: base_commit, head_commit and branch_name stay required; branch_state pushed or bundled, bundled requiring a source_bundle material; native resume material is the native_session material with native_session_id and native_harness_version; the normalized watermark is transcript_durable_cursor with non negative integer sequence and byte_offset plus the normalized_transcript material; exclusions stay required and are carried verbatim.
spec_coverage.reconstruction: reconstruction carries harness, image_digest, task_revision and execution_generation; schema_version carries the schema; an execution generation unequal to the authority task generation is scope_mismatch.
spec_coverage.completeness: Verdict.completeness is complete, incomplete or diagnostic_only; Verdict.continuation is native, context or none.
spec_coverage.manifest_commit: inventory sha256 and size must agree with artifact_hashes; Validator.commit stores the manifest only after every inventoried object reads back verified, under an immutable checkpoint id.
spec_coverage.state_obligation: See states: observed, accepted, committed and externally verified are separate outcomes, and only verify after commit returns authoritative.
spec_coverage.data_safety: See rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: the manifest object and the content addressed materials are authoritative, never caches, and rollback deletes neither; case C records the durable keys unchanged after rollback.
spec_coverage.completion_evidence: interfaces, supported_versions, validation (test and mutation run ids), remaining_limitations and rollback_rehearsal in this record, with the A, B and C case records and manifest.json.
spec_coverage.phase_use: Spot recovery on Anton workers and SV2-CKP-02 to SV2-CKP-04 call Validator.verify from the replacement attempt to choose native resume or context continuation without reaching the reclaimed node.
